title: METHODOLOGICAL FRAMEWORK FOR DEVELOPING AN AI-BASED DISTANCE LEARNING PLATFORM
reason: Framework paper with a quasi-experiment comparing AI-platform and control groups on self-report Likert scales (satisfaction, perceived effectiveness, engagement, TAM); platform analytics are described but no recorded measure is analysed.

extraction.n_quote: The study involved 60 students selected from universities
extraction.population: undergraduate students with technical/pedagogical profile, Kh. Dosmukhamedov Atyrau University
extraction.outcome_or_construct: self-reported satisfaction, learning effectiveness, engagement, technology adoption
extraction.notes: Sample size inconsistent: 'involved 120 undergraduate students' in one passage, '60 students ... two comparable groups of 30' in another. Cohen's d 0.95-1.20 are group differences on self-report scales.
